test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A trader marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows a discount of 10% on them. His gain percentage is:
solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling price (SP) = MP - Discount

Profit percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Cost price (CP) = 100 (assuming)

Marked price (MP) = 125% of CP = 125

Discount = 10% of 125 = 12.5

Selling price (SP) = 125 - 12.5

Selling price (SP) = 112.5

Profit = SP - CP

Profit = 112.5 - 100

Profit = 12.5

Profit percentage = (12.5 / 100) × 100

Profit percentage = 12.5%

**The gain percentage is 12.5%.**
